snippet.title: Last Egg Alive [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
Last Egg Alive features Eggy trying to survive as long as possible against the never ending platformer level. It has powerups like turning yourself tiny, lasers and more eggs. Compete with friends for the highest score!

Play this game and more at www.eggysgames.com
